The requested computable evaluator for actual constrained density slices is not delivered; certification is conditional on externally supplied exact labeled presentations, whose construction, emptiness, and boundary feasibility remain open.

proof_attempt_summary: Resumed the original unfinished claim, completed two D0 solve rounds and independent maximality adjudications, verified seven primary cited leaves, and separated source-exact Neyman–Pearson uniqueness from its own atomless bridge. D0.5 retains three field kernels as open: the all-regime original-law experiment, effective actual-slice evaluator, and sharp adaptation/common attainer; independent MAIN audit found no bounded repair and supports a terminal downgrade at incremental (raw referee subfield, score5 below7.4). The final graph contains11 discovery-proved,7 cited,3 open questions and12 other to-prove draft nodes after source/dependency revalidation invalidation; no F stages, Lean output, kernel certification or substrate promotion occurred.
tldr: Equality of unique global causal intrinsic means is studied under fair randomized assignment. Proved results include original-law full-information transfer, full-ball interior power benchmarks, a positive oracle-regret lower bound and the matched worst-class sixth-root order. This round strengthens contact displacement to an \(O(n^{-1/3})\) upper bound, gives a fixed-Fourier likelihood obstruction, and provides terminating conditional decision certificates with explicit inputs and errors. Uniform evaluation of arbitrary sequence power envelopes without effective convergence input is impossible. Sharp boundary experiments, certification of actual slices, matching adaptation values and an observable original-data sharp attainer remain objectives.
gap: Kurisu and Otsu allow singularity in one-sample empirical likelihood, but their two-sample Assumption 3 excludes different smeariness orders and Appendix A.6 uses inverse pooled-Jacobian linearization. Pal likewise requires positive Hessians for his two-sample correction. Existing objective-gap subsampling and mean-set relaxation do not supply the sharp all-data neighborhood power or the coupled globally level-constrained oracle regret.
fill: The kernel is a uniform original-law experiment for intrinsic equality, explicit finite decision certificates for its actual constrained slices, and a single observable test attaining the derived sharp adaptation envelopes under exact global size. Rates, constants, useful sufficient convergence conditions and any positive oracle regret are outputs.
